scope: Offline-only optimisation; no new hardware window, flash, or controller writes
cause_evidence: No 3-second cooldown exists. Complete lift is two NONE frames. Some qualified stationary TWO contacts were rejected when their fading ONE whole-profile centroid shifted despite fixed-region lobes remaining stationary.
change: Only for a previously qualified, stationary pair: positive electrode envelope must not grow, total response must initially fall to <=50%, and each credible fixed-support lobe must retain its peak station and remain within 12 native units of the FIRST TWO anchor. At least one credible residual lobe required. No normalization of weak supports. Subsequent fading-tail responses must remain non-increasing.
unchanged_guards: explicit opt-in and 60-second maximum RAW window
normal input restoration and button release safeguards
synthetic_regressions: ten clicks 130ms apart with complete two-frame lift
limitations: Physical tap count unknown; no hit-rate claim
Recorded data now used for development, not independent validation
RAW two-finger HID remains bounded experiment; not daily single/multi-touch coexistence
No claim of formal stable or production-ready multi-touch
